dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Coco Melon is at risk due to behavioral concerns. Coco Melon has not acclimated during his stay in care, despite efforts to keep him comfortable. Coco Melon has displayed intense leash biting beahviors whihc has made safely removing him from kennel for walks or interactions difficult. He has been unresponsive to handlers' attempts to redirect him with treats, toys, and high-value items due to the intensity of his fixation and leash biting. Coco Melon grabbed a handler's hand in the process during a recent attempt to leash him. The bite did not break the skin or draw blood. When removed from the kennel for his handling assessment, he was observed to kennel fight as he left the room. Medically, Coco Melon is apparently healthy.

Coco Melon was surrendered into care as a stray, so his past behavior in a home enviornment is unknown. Coco Melon has shown affiliative behaviors with handlers but has displayed a low threshold for arousal that has manifested as intense leash biting. He is difficult to redirect, which has made taking him for walks difficult to manage safely. Due to these concerns, we recommend Coco Melon be placed in an adult-only home through a New Hope rescue partner that can address these challenges with the use of a certified professional trainer that uses positive reinforcement-only methods.
